⚠️ COMMON COMPLEXITY PATTERNS IDENTIFIED
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

1. Large main() Functions
   Problem: Business logic embedded in main()
   Solution: Extract into modular functions
   Files: keymon, infoPanel, prompt, tweaks, themeSwitcher

2. Massive Switch Statements
   Problem: 10-15 case statements with complex logic
   Solution: Function pointer tables, command pattern
   Files: keymon, packageManager, gameSwitcher

3. Deep Nesting (4-5 levels)
   Problem: Multiple nested if statements
   Solution: Early returns, guard clauses, extraction
   Files: Multiple files across codebase

4. Mixed Concerns
   Problem: UI rendering mixed with business logic
   Solution: Separation of concerns, MVC-like patterns
   Files: infoPanel, prompt, tweaks, themeSwitcher

5. Complex State Management
   Problem: 10+ boolean flags tracking state
   Solution: State machine pattern, consolidated state structs
   Files: keymon, gameSwitcher, packageManager

💡 QUICK WIN OPPORTUNITIES
────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

1. Replace Deep Nesting with Early Returns
   Impact: -2 to -5 CCN per function
   Effort: Low
   
2. Extract Helper Functions
   Impact: -3 to -10 CCN per function
   Effort: Low to Medium
   
3. Use Function Pointer Tables
   Impact: -10 to -20 CCN per function
   Effort: Medium
